Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh

sentences.text: Counsel for Applicant :- Dharmendra Pratap Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 179 of 2022, under Sections 452, 376 I.P.C., Police Station Charthaval, District Muzaffarnagar, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant/accused that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The prosecutrix is a mature lady, aged 28 years.

The allegation of prosecutrix that on 07.06.2022, the applicant has committed rape upon her, is thoroughly false and that only vague allegation has been made that the applicant has committed rape upon her.
Prosecutrix has not sustained any injury.
It is further submitted that the prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial court, wherein she has not supported prosecution version and turned hostile.

She has clearly stated that applicant has not committed any rape upon her and Ummaid vs State Of U.P. on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184972923/
1
only a quarrel has taken place.
Other witnesses of fact namely, Firdaus (PW-2) and Tasavvar (PW-3), have also turned hostile before the trial court.

Lastly, it is submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 16.06.2022 having no criminal history and that in case he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail application.
However, it could not be disputed that prosecutrix has not supported the prosecution version before the trial court.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of allegations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

Let the applicant Ummaid involved in aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
2.The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
3.The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
4. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

5.The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 22.3.2023 Suraj  Ummaid vs State Of U.P. on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184972923/
